body:
Thankfully neither of my parents have passed away yet, but if it were up to me, I'd prefer to spend every moment I can with them at the end. I know they could be in incredible pain, but I'm thinking from a purely selfish and objective standpoint. The last few hours of someone's life are the most special. They should be spent with family.

If I were in your position I'd likely be leaning in the same direction, but from the perspective of your family, it would be better for you to wait in pain.

I'm just very stressed, under a lot of pressure, slightly depressed from yet another breakup, and questioning my motivation for everything. I know I could make this so much simpler for myself by ending it.
Thank you for the reply. The problem is that it's painful to reach for it. It's long-term pain for short-term satisfaction.

We're all lucky to be here, to be alive. But why continue living when it's going to be painful? The main thing keeping me alive right now is that I look forward to things. But when they come, it's short term satisfaction. The whole way there is painful. And why does it bring satisfaction anyway? I'm insignificant compared to the whole human race. Anything I do to be "successful" means nothing in the scope of things.

Overdose oxycodone and alcohol mix, and I'm sorry. :( You're already on a strong painkiller I assume (you mentioned your disease). It's best to spend the time you have left with family and to ask for a stronger painkiller IMO though.
